english.title: Furnish false information for registration / licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of obtaining for yourself or another

(A)_[registration under the Wildlife and Countryside (Registration to Sell etc Certain Dead Wild Birds) Regulations 1982,]_
(B)_[registration under the Wildlife and Countryside (Registration and Ringing of Certain Captive Birds) Regulations 1982,]_
(C)_[the grant of a licence under Section 16 of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981,]_

furnished a document or information which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly furnished a document or information which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17 and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 14(3) for defence
(ii) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes
(iii) See Section 21(6) for the forfeiture provisions.
(iv) As amended by paragraph 10 of Schedule 12 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(v) See also offence wording H4538 re furnishing false information.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
